Error: invalid argument "{2026-10-11" for "--start" flag: invalid timestamp, time must either be relative (1m, 5h, etc) or in RFC3339 format: 2026-10-11T09:01:04-07:00
Usage:
  bex logs [flags]

Examples:
  # Tail logs for a service
  bex logs --resources srv-abc123 --tail

  # Query logs in a time range
  bex logs --resources srv-abc123 --start 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --end 2026-03-01T01:00:00Z

  # Output logs as JSON in non-interactive mode
  bex logs --resources srv-abc123 --output json

Flags:
      --direction enum        Set log query direction (backward or forward)
      --end time              Filter logs at or before the specified end time
  -h, --help                  help for logs
      --host strings          Filter logs by comma-separated host values
      --instance strings      Filter logs by comma-separated instance IDs
      --level enum            Filter logs by comma-separated log levels
      --limit int             Limit the number of logs returned (default 100)
      --method enum           Filter logs by comma-separated HTTP methods
      --path strings          Filter logs by comma-separated request paths
  -r, --resources strings     Filter logs by comma-separated resource IDs (Required in non-interactive mode)
      --start time            Filter logs at or after the specified start time
      --status-code strings   Filter logs by comma-separated status codes
      --tail                  Stream new logs
      --task-id strings       Filter logs by comma-separated task IDs
      --task-run-id strings   Filter logs by comma-separated task run IDs
      --text strings          Filter logs by comma-separated text values
      --type enum             Filter logs by comma-separated log types

Global Flags:
      --confirm         Skip all confirmation prompts
  -o, --output string   Set output format to interactive, json, yaml, or text. Auto-switches to text on non-TTY (default "interactive")
